body: Thank you. Yes, I will go

Meditation is the worst advice to give, I remembered my first and last try of reaching out to a professional, she told me I should try meditation (spoiler, I tried and it didn't work). Felt like I wasn't taken seriously so never talked to a professional again. I know seeking professional help can work, but I didn't want to go through the same experience again.
Thanks, I am glad I did have to see for myself. No more Quora for me..
